build_swin_transformer_backbone: build a SwinTransformer backbone with custom depths, num_heads, and window_size for object detection
create_window_msa_module: create a WindowMSA module with relative position bias for window-based multi-head self-attention
create_shift_window_msa_module: create a ShiftWindowMSA module with cyclic shift and attention mask for shifted window attention
build_swin_block_sequence: build a SwinBlockSequence stage with configurable depth, window_size, and optional downsampling
convert_swin_weights: convert original Swin Transformer checkpoint weights to be compatible with MMDetection format
